This adjusts for that. uv.y = 1.0 - uv.y; // Sample the ambient occlusion texture and use it to set the // ambient occlusion value to use during rendering. auto tex = params.textures(); half metallic = tex.ambient_occlusion().sample(textureSampler, uv).r; params.surface().set_ambient_occlusion(metallic); ```
